document.abstract: The light valve has been used very widely as the modulating device in systems of film sound recording. In this paper the principles of operation of the light valve are discussed, and those engineering factors which prescribe limitations on performance and indicate operating advantages are described in detail. The type of distortion which results when a light valve is overloaded is depicted both for single-plane and two-plane valves. Finally, a new type of light valve having advantages from the standpoints of weight, size, and stability of operation is described.
